title: The Truthfulness of God
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The truthfulness of God means that God cannot lie, deceive, or speak falsely. His Word, promises, warnings, judgments, and revelations are true because He is true.
summary: The truthfulness of God means that God cannot lie, deceive, or speak falsely. His Word, promises, warnings, judgments, and revelations are true because He is true.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the truth and reveals the truthful God. In Him, God’s promises are confirmed, His Word is fulfilled, and sinners are called out of deception into light.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is true in Himself. He is not confused, dishonest, mistaken, or manipulative. Unlike human beings, God does not lie or change His mind out of weakness.

Because God is truthful, His Word is truth. Scripture’s truthfulness rests on God’s character. His promises can be trusted, His warnings must be taken seriously, and His Gospel is sure.

God’s truthfulness also exposes falsehood. Sin often survives by lies: lies about God, self, pleasure, guilt, shame, and salvation. God’s truth brings people into reality before Him.

In Christ, God’s truth is embodied and fulfilled. Jesus is not merely a teacher of true things; He is the truth who reveals the Father and brings sinners into the freedom of God’s Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People live in a world filled with distortion, half-truths, emotional manipulation, and spiritual deception. The truthfulness of God gives believers a solid place to stand.

This doctrine also heals mistrust. Human beings may lie, fail, or mislead, but God is not like sinful man. What He says is true, and what He promises in Christ is secure.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Trust God’s Word because God is true. Reject lies that contradict Scripture, whether they come from culture, shame, fear, temptation, or false teaching. Speak truthfully, walk honestly, and let the truth of Christ set you free.
